book.name: Mark
book.title: Mark ka Te Pabe'e Jesus, Te Naa Tooa'a-witu, Numu oo Tuukwena

content: Ka nanesootuhi nobe-kwi'yoona, sumu'yoo mu tunakatzimodu-matu ka Te Pabe'e meeoo netamma, “Esoo nanesootuhi nobe tupe noko namadabuepu-ga'yoo. Mu yaatu tupe papaba'yoo. Esoo nanesootuhi nobe besa tabu'a.”
Soo Te Pabe'e meeoo oo netamma, “Esoo nobe besa'yoo pana te wokwohomu no'oko a wuyoomedakwunikwu.”
Umu yise ka tuutsekoo giba-ma, Olive mee naneadu-kwitoo mease o aata'a, ka nanesootuhi nobe poonne. Peter, James, John, Andrew yise mee oo watse tubenga.
“How sakwa tamme oo sopedakwatoo tabua, ka nobe nuudyoomedakwuna? Hee te tzapoonnekukwu hannano'o oo manikwuna?”

Soo Te Pabe'e meeoo mu nanekwege'a, “Ewa'yoo numu meeoo naneyugwedu, yow numme Te Pabe'e. Nu gi mu esayaedu-matu, meeoo soo esayaedu mu tuukwekwu. Ewa'yoo mu numu nanemooagakwu. Gi mu naka'oedyukupana.
Tooe hanotu tooe mu numu mesoo nanago'e. Gi saa'a su'ipana. Gi soo te teepu suda mane-wa'ne'yoo, gi meeoo hemma sooyugwepana.
Mu numu yise nanano ewa nanagoekwu. Tooe hanotu tooe saa'a, soo te teepu yutsungadooa. Mu numu saa'a tseagoedooa. Gi besow saa'a hemma mu poonnedooa.”

Soo Te Pabe'e yise mee mu netamma, “Mu sakwa namasootzema. Mu sumuna nahemase, mu nanehanedooa. Mu saa'a nuupagetadooa. Mu gi e naka'oedyukudu saa'a gi mu petzabedooa. Mu yise nuga besa unnepu mu tuukwedooa.
No'obatusoo mu numu saa'a e unnepu nakadooa.
Mu ka nakwutumase, gi suda oo soonamekupana ka hayoo mu unnekwuna. Soo Te Naa Besa Pooha ooka mada'e.
Ewa'yoo mu numu gi e petzabedooa, mu nananumudooe suda mu matugudooa, yise mu goedooa saa'a. Ka umu gi e soo'oedyukudu, gi mumme numu petzabedu, gi e naka'oedyukudu, gi e ma'wukadu, nu magwetzoikwu.
Tooe hemma tooe suta'yoo
ka nanesootuhi nobe-kobena natzekwunukukwu. O'no sakwa mu ka oo poonnese, Judea-wi'yoona yabesoo mea'a.
Oosoo tu nobe-kobena wununnummedu sakwa gi tu nobe-kwitu hemma gwuupana, yabesoo meeow.
Soo tubewabe-kwitu hemma how yugwewunudu sakwa punno'o gi hemma gwuupana, gi tu nobe-kwitoo kodyupana, yabesoo meeow.
Ka yabesoo mea'akwuse, mu koheadu-kwi gi besa, ka mu sutuba mea'akwuse mu oonga'a petzekudu punno'o.
Umu sakwa nanesootuhi gi sakwa tommo hee oo suda manepana.
Esoo gi besa a namanekwuna tubetse unu suda, gi hannano'o namanedu ka teepu namadabuese.
Te Naa yise ka umu tu tutzeanana sootuhikwu, ka gi oo tzadyoo'ikuna gi haga namagwetzo'i-wa'ne'yoo.
Tooe haga tooe sumuna meeoo mu tuukwekwu, ‘Soo Te Pabe'e mooasoo kodyu petu.’ Gi oo naka oedyukupana.

Ewa tuwazoo na'esagoekwu, ‘Nu Yow Mu Pabe'e mee na'unnekwu.’ Ewasoo mu numu moohedu numu nemooagayakwe. Nanasookwugi hemma mu tzapoonnekukwu, tooe hemma tooe pooha mahanekwu, ka umu e dooamu too'e nemooagana.
Mooasoo nu mu tuukwepu. Ooonne'yoona sakwa mu namasootzemapunne.
O'no ka gi hemma besa manekwuse, soo taba toganohookwu, soo muha punno'o.
Mu paatoozooba punno'o sawedyikwu.
No'yoona mu numu punno'o ka koomeba-nagakoo e pooha kodyu petukwuna poonnekwu.
Umu toha kakasa-ga'yoo e tutummatzikwutu, tooe hanotu tooe ka yaa teepu-kooba'yoona, mu e nanumu nu-baa hanepetukwu.
Ka sunngabe pooedooase, mu meeoo sokwamadooa, tamme tookwa tamatsebooe.
Ka gi besa hemma manekese, mu yise oo sopedakwadookwu, nu tookwa pudusoo kodyu petukwu.
Susumudu mu numu-matu ka hemma oo manedu poonnekwu gisoo ya'ena.
Nuga unnepu besa na'unnedu, gi atasoo naneyugwe-wa'ne'yoo.

Ka hannano'o oe e petuookwuna manepetuse, gi haga ka teepu-koobatu oo sopedakwatoo. Mu toogoopatu Te Naa tutummatzidu puu gi, nu punno'o gi. Te Naa suu'mu oo sopedakwadoopunne ka hannano'o e petuookwuna.
Mu sakwa ooosapa namasootzemapunne.
Nu-kwa'nesoo, sumu'yoo numu puu ka meakwuse, ka hemma how pumme yugwekudu hemma nemanekuga. Ka tu'eyaedu meeoo netamma, ‘Gi u'wepana.’
Mu sakwa nonotsu tabeno nuummabetsabena. Tooe hannano'o tooe nu kemmowgena, yongona, togano, awamooasoo. Nu sumuna gi mu nuummabetsape mu mayu petukwu.”

footnotes.text: Tamme sakwa oo sopedakwatoo ka hemma sutahoo ka Te Pabe'e tuukwe-kwitu.
